name: Context Advanced Datalayer
description: Allows site admins to setup Datalayer page variables using Contexts module
project_description:
The Advanced GTM Datalayer module provides flexible possibility to manipulate Data Layer page variables .

 This module is API module and provides base plugins code and admin part to create and manipulate your own Data Layer page variables (tags).

 Features: 

 
 Manipulate global default site tags values 
 Manipulate tags values on entity and bundle level 
 Manipulate tags values on specific entity level (Datalayer tags field type) 
 Token integration 
 Inheritance and overriding system 
 
 Submodule 'Context Advanced Datalayer' integrate Context and allowed override Data Layer tags based on different conditions from context.

 Submodule 'Advanced Datalayer example' provides code examples of several tags.
